LongPIBench
	

LongPIBench is a benchmark release containing 100 linked examples. Each example
is identified by an integer from 0 through 99 and contains:

a complete multi-file LaTeX paper project in papers/<id>/;
structured personal-profile data in person_info/<id>.json;
an email exchange and attachment text in emails/<id>.json; and
a before/after programming task in code_changes/<id>.json.

The directory structure is part of the dataset. In particular, each paper is a
raw LaTeX… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RainWatcher/LongPIBench.
